author: pgaudet
body:
Hi @sandraorchard 

This paper was flagged as part of the new term requested here: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32788

PMID:28566324

I had Claude check the main text, the figures and the supplement, PMID:28566324 supports ISR for ATF4 only. The 22 complex-level annotations and the NAS  annotations on all 21 partner proteins have no support from this reference.

Can you please have a look ? 

Thanks, Pascale
title: Complex Portal: review annotations to PMID:28566324

author: sandraorchard
body:
Hi
Yes, correct, it did take inference a step too far. I'm not a big fan of ISR as a term anyway, so have just removed the annotation from all complexes.
